create_sandbox_backend: create a sandbox using SandboxBackend.create with thread_id, sandbox_id, and optional extra_mounts
destroy_sandbox_backend: destroy a sandbox using SandboxBackend.destroy with a SandboxInfo object
wait_for_sandbox_ready: wait for a sandbox to be ready by polling its health endpoint at a given URL with timeout
discover_sandbox_backend: discover an existing sandbox by its deterministic sandbox_id using SandboxBackend.discover
list_running_sandboxes: list all running sandboxes managed by a SandboxBackend instance
